summary: Aermotor fire tower built near Carthage in 1951; moved to Burke County in 1990, where it stands on a private tract.

facts.design: Aermotor tower with 7 by 7 ft cab
facts.status_note: Moved in 1990 from near Carthage, Moore County, to Burke County. No source describes the original site today.

access.note: The tower stands on a private tract inside South Mountains State Park, per the register entry for its present site. No source says the public may climb it.

events.note: Built by the NC Forest Service near Carthage as a 100-foot Aermotor tower with a 7 by 7 ft cab.
Moved from near Carthage in Moore County to Burkemont Mountain in Burke County, where the register lists it as Walker Top Lookout.

notes_for_editor: The record covers the original site near Carthage and the tower's present site, Walker Top Lookout (NHLR US 728, NC 22) in Burke County, because the tower was moved in 1990. The NHLR registration belongs to the Walker Top entry, not to this Carthage record. The staffing end date (late 1990s) rests on one personal Flickr caption, so confidence is medium. A Facebook group post repeats the 1951 and 1990 dates but could not be fetched, so it is not cited. The 1930-32 courthouse lookout is a separate listing and appears only as context in the story. Brief status 'unknown' is replaced by 'relocated' and brief access 'unknown' by the private-tract description of the present tower. No brief field was contradicted.
